intent-keys.title: Intent Keys
intent-keys.promise: Learn the keyboard keys that replace the mouse, one tool at a time.

audience: People who have vibe coded for about a year and still steer with the mouse.

howMaxTalks: Casual and first person. He learns the keys with the viewer: "I'm learning them too, so the mistakes stay in."
Says the key out loud, then presses it.
Short reactions after a key lands: "Boom." "Hey, look at that." "There it is."
Names his own mistakes on camera: "See, I made a mistake." "Another flub, add to the counter."
openQuestions: Max has not supplied a list of words he never uses or claims he will not make.

format.ending: Closing brand card and 10-second bumper end the video.
format.maxOnScreen: Max stays on screen the whole episode: camera full frame for the sheet and homework, a corner box everywhere else.
format.callsToAction: One subscribe ask, in the close, with its reason: next week's payoff.

captions.short: Burned-in captions on a dark backing.

rules: Tight crop so the command and the key overlay read on a phone.
Use Max's supplied Short title and end cards.
List the source range for each moment.

packaging.thumbnail: Max's face, the tool name, and one key in big type on the sheet's color. Max makes it.
packaging.description: Carries the sheet link, so the homework card can say "link in the description".
packaging.pinnedComment: The homework, plus "Post your clip and tag us."

editing.cutRule: Cut in a measured pause. Never cut on caption or Whisper word times alone.
editing.privacy: Blur home-folder names and personal widgets. Flag any other name, email, key or notification.
